To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the majority of algorithms have statistically indistin- guishable bias and variance values under different sampling methods, and different sampling methods have similar run times.

(i) the majority of algorithms produce similar bias and variance values when validated using LOO or N-way, (ii) the runtimes of LOO and N-way are similar and (iii) LOO is deterministic and hence reproducible, whereas N-way is not.
LOO and N-way are equivalent in terms of B&V values generated, and LOO is deterministic, which makes it easier to replicate.
